# TC.Config.Read.SectionValues

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.Config.Read.SectionValues"></a>

### TC.Config.Read.SectionValues

Section values. Addition defaults: active=true, empty group, multiplier=1, and empty local filters. Group joins inherit shared filters. Unknown fields are refused.

### active (optional)

Section activation. The addSection default is true. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
boolean
```

### filters (optional)

Complete replacement for section filters. The addSection default is empty only for a local group. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
(TC.Config.Read.SectionFilter)[]
```

### group (optional)

Shared-group name. An empty string means local. This is the addSection default. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
string
```

### multiplier (optional)

Section output multiplier. The addSection default is 1. Readback uses native float32 precision. Native numeric readback must be finite. Generic Data limits still apply. Explicit root patch clear: not supported.

```text
number
```
